tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search the Dimore d'Epoca collection of historic hotels (castles, villas, palazzi, abbeys, country relais, historic residences) in Italy, France, Spain and other European countries. Returns properties that can be booked online, with id, location, type, rating, pool, pets and page link.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Full details of one Dimore d'Epoca property: description, highlights, services, check-in/out, pets, children, parking, coordinates, photo and page link.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Live availability and prices for a property, read from the property's own booking engine. Returns the bookable room/rate options with total price in EUR for the whole stay (taxes included, city tax excluded), cancellation terms when the property provides them, and a room_key identifying each option.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates a booking request for a room option (room_key) and returns a secure Stripe payment link (payment_url) that the guest opens and pays. tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Status of a booking request by booking_id: whether the guest has paid (card authorised) and whether the property has confirmed or declined.

tools.name: buy_gift_card
tools.description: Buy a Dimore d'Epoca digital gift card (EUR 20-3000, valid 12 months on all properties and experiences of the collection). Returns a Stripe payment link for the buyer; after payment the gift card (code + PDF) is emailed to the buyer and, if given, to the recipient on the chosen date.
